stem.text: Compressive forces are applied normally to the end faces of a cylinder of initial length $L$. The cylinder is compressed by the forces so that its length decreases to $0.6L$. After the compressive forces are removed, the cylinder’s length increases to $0.8L$.

stem.alt: Drawing of a horizontal cylinder with the label cylinder and a dimension line marked L. Caption: before compressive forces applied.
Drawing of a horizontal cylinder with arrows at both ends pointing inwards, and a dimension line marked 0.6L. Caption: compressive forces applied.
Drawing of a horizontal cylinder with a dimension line marked 0.8L. Caption: after compressive forces removed.
